projects.title: Organization and Date Extraction from Public Reports

bullets.text: Under supervision, implemented reusable Python modules for the extraction workflow and wrote pytest regression tests for malformed and edge-case inputs as an individual contribution to a two-student capstone.

Under supervision, compared rule-based extraction using Python re with pretrained spaCy extraction on held-out annotated company report excerpts; checked span precision and recall and analyzed errors by entity type.
Under supervision, validated pandas merges with duplicate-key and unmatched-record checks, and used Matplotlib to visualize how group comparisons changed under alternative cleaning rules.
